label: Albert Einstein, On the Electrodynamics of…: Under the stated relativity and light-speed…
locator: §2, first two postulates and final paragraphs beginning “We imagine further that with each clock” and “So we see”
interpretation: Prose-only primary-translation reading. This is a source argument under named physical/synchronization assumptions. It is not read as saying every pair of simultaneous events becomes nonsimultaneous, or that an additional privileged-present ontology has been refuted.
